summary: Adapt standing GitHub repository watches from three to six to ten minutes while quiet

schema.detail: Quiet cadence is in-memory observer/revision scheduling state, separate from provider cursors and cached responses.

rules.detail: Watch delivery and admission rules are unchanged; no per-thread pollers are introduced.

compatibility.detail: Standing repository observers start at three minutes, advance to six then ten minutes when facts are unchanged, and reset to three minutes on any observed fact change. Existing standing every=30s declarations adapt by identity without rewriting live state. Explicit non-standing intervals, including faster 30s observers, remain unchanged. Pagination continues at one second; provider rate-limit retry deadlines remain authoritative.

downtime.detail: No data migration or daemon restart is performed by this change.

manual.detail: New standing declarations use every=3m. Refresh remains immediate and resets active cadence; a new revision starts immediately at active cadence.

recovery.detail: Restart resets quiet cadence to active without clearing ETags, response bodies or provider cursor state. Successful receipts retain a conservative three-minute restart deadline; effective six/ten-minute deadlines stay in memory and use canonical observation outcomes, not raw delta JSON or receipt writes. Binary rollback requires no migration.
